offers_products.reason: Makes disposable medical devices: catheters, embolics, stents, dialysis access, inflation devices, kits and packs.

offers_services.reason: Sells devices; physician training and clinical support are secondary to the product portfolio.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Clinicians and healthcare systems choose and buy the devices; patients do not pick them.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hospitals and healthcare systems, cath labs and distributors worldwide.

recurring_revenue.reason: Disposable single-use devices, kits and packs are reordered repeatedly by hospitals for ongoing procedures.

cyclical_demand.reason: Devices are used in necessary medical procedures such as dialysis, cardiac catheterization and cancer care.

big_ticket.reason: Disposable devices are low-cost, frequently purchased supplies rather than large capital purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured medical devices, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are hospital systems, group purchasing organizations and large distributors, plus government health systems.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs its own manufacturing plants and global distribution, which need continuing capital investment.
